content.content:
Done. Phase 4 (Users & sync) validation complete.

## Summary
The Phase 4 webapp work is **substantially validated**. The frontend (the primary webapp UI deliverable) is fully implemented and tested. However, validation found **2 untracked backend bugs** that mean 3 of the 6 Phase 4 acceptance criteria are only partially met — I've created issues for both so they can be triaged.

## Validation results

| Check | Result |
|-------|--------|
| Phase 4 e2e suite (38 tests) | ✅ 38/38 pass |
| Frontend typecheck (tsc) | ✅ clean |
| Frontend production build (vite) | ✅ passes |
| E2E isolation (main .agentrack/ untouched) | ✅ clean — 0 test issues leaked, config intact |
| global-setup data reset | ✅ fires (_e2edata branch defaults) |

## Acceptance criteria vs. reality
- ✅ Register a new user via the UI — fully met
- ✅ Revoke a user — fully met
- ⚠️ Regenerate a token — **PARTIAL** (frontend works; backend BUG-1 → 401)
- ⚠️ Push sync — **PARTIAL** (frontend triggers call; backend BUG-2 → 500)
- ⚠️ Pull sync — **PARTIAL** (frontend triggers call; backend BUG-2 → 500)
- ✅ Sync status feedback clear — fully met (push/pull buttons, loading/success/error UI all validated)

## Issues I created (both untracked until now — only existed as code comments)
- **mqe162cmbi** — BUG-1: regenerate returns 401. Root cause in `packages/webapp/server/routes/users.ts:54` (server doesn't forward user token; resolveAuthor returns 'anonymous'). webapp server bug.
- **mqe162svv5** — BUG-2: sync push/pull returns 500. Root cause in `packages/webapp/server/routes/sync.ts` (passes AGENTRACK_CWD worktree dir to pushWorktree/pullWorktree instead of project root). webapp server bug.

⚠️ Heads-up for whoever fixes these: the Phase 4 e2e tests currently ASSERT the buggy behavior (expect 401 / 500), so fixing the bugs will make 5 tests start failing — they must be rewritten to assert success at the same time.

## Pre-existing Phase 1-3 failures (outside Phase 4 scope)
The full suite showed 10 Phase 1-3 failures. Investigation: **7 are consistent + up to 3 are flaky** (shared-state ordering — all 3 pass in isolation with `--grep`). This matches what the developer reported and is already tracked in PM epic **mqdzlo4ia8** (Deliverables A/B/C). No Phase 4 regressions.

## Recommendation
Phase 4 frontend work is validated and can be considered delivered. The regenerate-token and sync push/pull flows cannot be considered fully done until mqe162cmbi and mqe162svv5 are resolved — those are the gaps that close out the last 3 acceptance criteria.
